mapper.select: SELECT r.role_code FROM sys_role r INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1
SELECT r.id, r.role_code, r.role_name, r.description, r.status, r.builtin FROM sys_role r INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = ur.user_id WHERE ur.role_id = #{roleId} AND u.deleted = 0
